verdicts.reason: Both stretch the circle into a squashed ellipse and blow the tagline up larger than the 'Lumen & Fig' wordmark, which inverts the brand hierarchy; the fig mark also sits jammed against the ellipse's left edge. In A, the one-line tagline runs nearly to both sides of the ellipse and looks cramped, but it overpowers the wordmark less. In B, the tagline wraps to two lines and dominates even more, and the fig stem crowds the ellipse's upper edge.
